content.stem: 反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义措施的有效性，可通过系统和控制措施在多大程度上做到以下事项来衡量：

options.B: 最大限度降低金融机构的运营负担
options.C: 减轻金融犯罪的风险和威胁
options.D: 以经济高效的方式实施

content.stem_en: The effectiveness of AML/CFT measures can be best measured by the extent to which systems and controls:

options_en.A: Comply with relevant laws and regulations
options_en.B: Minimize the operational burden placed on the financial institution
options_en.C: Mitigate the risks and threats of financial crime
options_en.D: Are implemented in a cost-effective way
